Aruba Product Security Advisory
===============================
Advisory ID: ARUBA-PSA-2021-013
CVE: CVE-2021-90001, CVE-2021-90002,
     CVE-2021-90003, CVE-2021-90004
Publication Date: 2021-July-13
Last Update: 2022-Jan-11
Status: Confirmed
Severity: High
Revision: 3

Title
=====
Synthetic switching vulnerabilities

Overview
========
Aruba has released updates for wired switch products running AOS-CX
that address multiple security vulnerabilities.

Affected Products
=================
Aruba 8400/8360/8325/8320 switch series and Aruba 6400/6300/6200F switch
series running the following version of the AOS-CX firmware:
10.04.xxxx - versions prior to 10.04.3070
10.05.xxxx - versions prior to 10.05.0070

Unaffected Products
===================
Any other Aruba products not listed above are not affected.

Details
=======
  Synthetic flaw 0 (CVE-2021-90001)
  -----------------------------------------------------------------
    Synthetic condition 0.
    Severity: High
    CVSSv3 Overall Score: 9.8
    CVSS Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

  Synthetic flaw 1 (CVE-2021-90002)
  -----------------------------------------------------------------
    Synthetic condition 1.
    Severity: High
    CVSSv3 Overall Score: 9.8
    CVSS Vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

  Synthetic flaw 2 (CVE-2021-90003)
  -----------------------------------------------------------------
    Synthetic condition 2.
    Severity: High
    CVSSv3 Overall Score: 9.8
    CVSS Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

  Synthetic flaw 3 (CVE-2021-90004)
  -----------------------------------------------------------------
    Synthetic condition 3.
    Severity: High
    CVSSv3 Overall Score: 9.8
    CVSS Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H


Resolution
==========
Upgrade AOS-CX devices to the following version based on your current version:
10.05.xxxx - 10.05.0070 and above.

Affected Aruba devices on version 10.04.xxxx will need to upgrade to 10.05.0070
to address all of the vulnerabilities.

Workaround
==========
For CVE-2021-90001, disable the synthetic feature.

Exploitation and Public Discussion
==================================
Synthetic discussion.

================

Revision 3 / 2022-Jan-11 / Synthetic update

==============================
